verdict.rationale: Homepage marketing says Hummingbird "automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team," which implies built-in agents that cases can be handed to. It also mentions customizable automation for screening and dispositioning alerts. This is a single thin, ambiguous marketing claim with no documentation of an AI assistant users can delegate to. missing for 10: documentation of a built-in AI assistant or agent, how users delegate tasks to it, what tasks it can perform, controls and review of its output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
